title: hybrid-d77 20261113
content:
hybrid-d77 is a proof-of-concept distribution based on Chimera Linux, a project that combines the Linux kernel with the BSD userland (FreeBSD's chimerautils) and the APK package manager from Alpine Linux. Hence the reason for the word "hybrid" in the distribution's name - it refers to the unusual fusion of various BSD and Linux components the result of which is a unique, hybrid operating system. The project offers two separate live images that feature either the niri compositor with the custom-built Utumno desktop shell (a Quickshell fork) or the Sway compositor with a Waybar bar. hybrid-d77 uses the Dinit init system and provides two system installation programs, a command-line one as well as a graphical installation tool called "Mocinha".
